[[File:Gualaar-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|300px|A [[Gualaar/Legends|Gualaar]], an ungulate native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]]]
'''Ungulates''' were [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that had hooves, or claws that evolved from hooves. Some ungulate species would chew their cuds.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
Examples of ungulates included the [[Peckva]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]], [[Kybuck/Legends|Kybuck]] and [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]].<ref name="NEGAS" />
